request: Fix the executor environment and revision handling. Ensure test commands run through the project Python environment using 'python -m pytest' instead of bare 'pytest', or detect missing pytest and install it into the active environment before running tests. Also fix the revision counter so tasks fail exactly at the configured MAX_REVISIONS limit and never attempt a 4th revision when max is 3.
title: Fix executor environment and revision handling
goals: Ensure test commands run through the project Python environment using 'python -m pytest'.
Detect missing pytest in the environment and install it if necessary before running tests.
Fix the revision counter to ensure tasks fail exactly at the configured MAX_REVISIONS limit.
constraints: Do not modify existing source files outside the executor environment and revision handling logic.
Ensure compatibility with the current project setup and dependencies.
success_criteria: Tests run successfully using 'python -m pytest' in the project environment.
Pytest is installed automatically if missing before tests are executed.
Tasks fail at the configured MAX_REVISIONS limit without exceeding it.
